evals.prompt: Review an AI assistant that drafts a marketing email but requires the user to click Send.
evals.expected_output: Focus on fit/reliance/legibility/control as relevant and avoid inventing high-risk autonomy concerns.
expectations: Does not demand approval for the already-user-controlled Send action unless another risk exists.
Distinguishes generated draft from external action.

evals.prompt: Review an agent that can permanently delete customer records after a natural-language request.
evals.expected_output: Flag proportional autonomy and human control as critical concerns.
expectations: Requires explicit approval before irreversible action.
Treats rollback/reversibility as a core design requirement.

evals.prompt: Review a normal deterministic settings page with no AI behavior.
evals.expected_output: State that this skill should not be the primary reviewer.
expectations: Routes away from AI Interaction Quality rather than fabricating AI findings.

evals.prompt: A product team upgrades its LLM provider and sees no build errors. Review the release risk.
evals.expected_output: Treat model behavior as a regression-sensitive dependency.
expectations: Does not treat successful compilation as sufficient verification.
